summary: Configured Nginx on node1 to serve HTTP 200 at / on TCP port 6700. SELinux and firewalld rules are persistent, and the service recovered successfully after a verified node reboot.
actions_performed: Created and validated a dedicated Nginx server block for TCP 6700.
Assigned TCP 6700 the SELinux http_port_t label.
Opened TCP 6700 in the active and permanent firewalld configuration.
Rebooted node1 safely and verified persistence using a changed boot ID.
Confirmed http://10.100.132.10:6700/ returns HTTP 200 after reboot.

evidence.requirement: Nginx serves a successful HTTP response at / on TCP port 6700
evidence.summary: Before and after reboot, Nginx was active and enabled, listening on IPv4 and IPv6 port 6700, and returned HTTP 200 with the expected body through $NODE_IP.

evidence.requirement: Persistent SELinux and firewall access for TCP 6700
evidence.summary: TCP 6700 is labeled http_port_t while SELinux remains enforcing, and firewalld reports the port allowed in both runtime and permanent state after reboot.

evidence.requirement: Mandatory node1 restart and recovery sequence
evidence.summary: Healthy baseline boot ID a1be807a-f931-4328-b608-cd61f894ed55 was captured, the native reboot was acknowledged, boot ID changed to 2701ef10-7953-40a4-a122-845bf613a7a6, and Nginx, listener, security rules, configuration, and HTTP 200 response were verified after recovery.
